verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is itself framed as 'an open-source AI agent' using a ReAct loop to autonomously act on tasks like debugging, rebasing, PR triage, and code generation (gemini-cli-gh-23, gemini-cli-docs-3, gemini-cli-gh-3/4/10/11), fully matching the delegate-to-built-in-assistant story. However, hands-on community reports show real caveats: users report the agent hallucinating and destructively mismanaging files, ignoring GEMINI.md instructions, jumping straight to code without a plan mode, and being weaker at complex delegated tasks than competitors, which tempers reliability of the delegation experience. Missing for 10: consistent hands-on corroboration of dependable task delegation without hallucination/data-loss incidents, and a documented plan/confirm mode for higher-stakes delegated tasks.
